---
title: "Funding Finder for Statistics"
description: "Explore funding opportunities relevant to statisticians."
---

::: {.finder-shell}
::: {.finder-intro}
::: {.intro-copy}
<p class="eyebrow">Research & Scholarship funding</p>

# Funding Finder for Statistics

Explore curated opportunities where statisticians can lead, collaborate or develop their research and scholarship careers.
:::

::: {.review-date}
<span class="review-icon" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
<span>Last reviewed<strong id="last-reviewed">01 October 2026</strong></span>
:::
:::

<div class="status-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Filter opportunities">
  <button class="status-tab" type="button" data-status="all" aria-selected="false">All <span id="count-all">41</span></button>
  <button class="status-tab is-active" type="button" data-status="OPEN" aria-selected="true">Open now <span id="count-open">29</span></button>
  <button class="status-tab" type="button" data-status="RESEARCH" aria-selected="false">Research <span id="count-research">41</span></button>
  <button class="status-tab" type="button" data-status="SCHOLARSHIP" aria-selected="false">Scholarship <span id="count-scholarship">0</span></button>
  <button class="status-tab" type="button" data-status="FORTHCOMING" aria-selected="false">Forthcoming <span id="count-forthcoming">8</span></button>
  <button class="status-tab" type="button" data-status="ROLLING" aria-selected="false">No closing date <span id="count-rolling">5</span></button>
  <button class="status-tab" type="button" data-status="MONITOR" aria-selected="false">Past / monitor <span id="count-monitor">4</span></button>
</div>

::: {.finder-toolbar}
<label class="search-field">
  <span class="visually-hidden">Search opportunities</span>
  <span aria-hidden="true">⌕</span>
  <input id="funding-search" type="search" placeholder="Search opportunity, funder or theme" autocomplete="off">
</label>

<label>
  <span class="visually-hidden">Filter by funder</span>
  <select id="funder-filter"><option value="all">All funders</option></select>
</label>

<label>
  <span class="visually-hidden">Filter by funding type</span>
  <select id="type-filter"><option value="all">All funding types</option></select>
</label>

<button id="reset-filters" class="reset-button" type="button">Reset filters</button>
:::

<div class="results-summary" aria-live="polite">
  <strong id="results-count">31 opportunities</strong>
  <span>Sorted by earliest deadline</span>
</div>

<div id="finder-loading" class="finder-message">Loading funding opportunities…</div>
<div id="finder-error" class="finder-message finder-error" hidden>Funding opportunities could not be loaded.</div>
<div id="finder-empty" class="finder-message" hidden>No opportunities match these filters.</div>

<div id="desktop-results" class="table-frame" hidden>
  <table class="funding-table">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Status</th>
        <th>Deadline</th>
        <th>Opportunity</th>
        <th>Funder</th>
        <th>Type</th>
        <th>Funding / duration</th>
        <th><span class="visually-hidden">Details</span></th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody id="funding-table-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>

<div id="mobile-results" class="funding-cards" hidden></div>

<p class="source-note"><span aria-hidden="true">ⓘ</span> Deadlines and eligibility can change. Always check the official funder page before preparing an application.</p>
:::

<div id="drawer-backdrop" class="drawer-backdrop" hidden></div>
<aside id="detail-drawer" class="detail-drawer" aria-labelledby="drawer-title" aria-hidden="true">
  <button id="drawer-close" class="drawer-close" type="button" aria-label="Close opportunity details">×</button>
  <div id="drawer-content"></div>
</aside>
